name: Typesense Search
description: Faster, typo-tolerant, multilingual search powered by a Typesense engine you point it at — Typesense Cloud or your own server. When it's unreachable, search automatically falls back to the built-in engine, so enabling this is never a hard dependency.
author: Convoro

settings.label: Typesense server URL
settings.help: e.g. https://xxx.a1.typesense.net or http://127.0.0.1:8108 (no trailing slash needed).

settings.label: API key
settings.help: An admin or search API key for your Typesense instance. Stored server-side; never exposed to visitors.

settings.label: Collection name
settings.help: The Typesense collection topics are indexed into. The default is fine for most installs.
